newsitem.title: USA: BPA drops Thursday peak firm power $2.00/MWh.
newsitem.headline: BPA drops Thursday peak firm power $2.00/MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) again offered 300 megawatts of peak firm power for Thursday delivery, while cutting prices by another $2.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Wednesday.

BPA offered peak firm power for Thursday at $13.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest sales, down from $15.00 for Wednesday, and at $14.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales, compared with $16.00 for Tuesday.
Since the beginning of the week, BPA's peak firm prices for COB have fallen $18.00 per MWh.
BPA continued to offer unlimited peak firm power during light load hours on Thursday at $9.00 a MWh.
Thursday non-firm power from hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 was also unchanged at $9.00 for all deliveries, while deliveries during hours ending 0600 and 2300 were offered at $10.00.
